sobre.meta_description: Vitachy: Spanish brand of functional homeware. Every drop matters: don't waste the product, don't waste time, don't throw out what still works.
sobre.hero_subtitle: Three ways not to waste: not the product, not the time, not the objects. That's Vitachy.
sobre.one_body: A well-made dosing pump delivers exactly the right amount every time. Not a drop more. A bottle lasts twice as long. Soap, oil and shampoo end up where they should, not in the sink.
sobre.two_body: Refill, press, done. No caps to unscrew, no streams to aim, no sticky hands. Our products are made for the quick gesture of daily life: in the kitchen, at the basin, in the shower.
sobre.three_title: Don't throw out what still works.
sobre.three_body: Pumps that last ten thousand cycles. Silicone bases that absorb the bump that breaks the glass. Bottles that refill and start over. Buy once well, instead of badly five times.
sobre.company_title: A Spanish brand of everyday objects.
sobre.company_body: Vitachy is a brand by VITACHY SPAIN SL, based in Palma de Mallorca and Terrassa. We design and curate products you would buy for your own home: useful, beautiful, honest.
